title: File:Chaolung Sukapha Toron (Gate), Charaideo Moidam,.jpg
author: BhuyanBhaskar
description: Chaolung Sukapha Toran (Gate) refers to a prominent gate or memorial archway dedicated to Chaolung Sukapha, the legendary founder and first king of the Ahom Kingdom, who ruled Assam for nearly 600 years (1228–1826).
period_note: Tradition spans 13th–19th centuries; individual visible mound and restoration must be dated
classification_note: Tai-Ahom funerary reference. Mounds are not palace or dwelling designs; modern shelters, gates and landscaping require exclusion.
classification_method: source metadata and user reference taxonomy; no full per-image visual audit
patronage_context: Ahom-period context where identified; patronage does not determine architectural tradition
